author: murphyc2
name: NorMuon + EMA + Cosine Warmdown
blurb: SP-1024 9x512 KV4 with MLP_MULT=3.0 (hidden=1536), seq_len=4096, NorMuon optimizer (adaptive per-row step sizes via second moment), EMA weight averaging (decay=0.999), cosine warmdown schedule, int6 per-row quantization on MLP+attention with fp16 tied embedding passthrough, zstd-22 compression, and sliding window evaluation at stride=64.
